verdict.rationale: Paxos publishes a structured per-endpoint API reference (transfers, fiat transfers, an introduction with OAuth auth) and a Sandbox environment for testing calls. Nothing shows that the reference itself is interactive or offers runnable examples, and probes for a published OpenAPI spec all returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-browser 'try it' console or playground, runnable code samples in the reference, an accessible OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration.
